about_the_game:
Undead Menace As you embark on a new adventure, you could hardly imagine that treasure hunt in ancient caves could turn into a survival game! The local undead are very much against the fact that you decided to enrich yourself at their expense and rose from the graves, trying to hit you with deadly magic! But will that stop you? Overcome obstacles on your way to the coveted gold, dodge enemies and deadly traps. Will you be able to overcome all the deadly levels and get to the very end? Undead Menace is a 2D platformer, going after the positive character Teonu, overcome terrible and rattling caves on your way, filled with many monsters of the past

Peculiarities:
- Nice graphics
- Nice soundtrack By QUE Sounds

short_description: Undead Menace - A brave girl went in search of treasures in ancient caves, despite the legend of the immortal guardians of jewels. She is sure that her passion for treasures cannot be stopped by neither skeletal magicians, nor dangerous chasms and traps!
